## Type of change

<!-- Mark one with an "x". -->

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] infra: build, tooling or dependencies
- [ ] ci: GitHub Actions or other CI/CD changes
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] refactor: code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] test: adding or updating tests

## Checklist

- [ ] `yarn lint`, `yarn format:check`, `yarn test` and `yarn build` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated (coverage must stay at or above 95%)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, ACCESSIBILITY.md) if behavior changed
- [ ] Keyboard play and sound still work, and `yarn test:a11y` passes, if the UI was touched
